module: "Marketplace" career debug tab. Shows the inventory vehicles (and whether they are for sale via career_modules_marketplace.findVehicleListing), the current listings with their offers (value, gap, remaining time) and Accept/Decline buttons, plus a 'Generate Random Offer' button.
notes: Probable bug: drawDebugMenu reads the global variables listedVehicles and offerTTL, which are not defined anywhere in this file (nil); the 'Current Listings' section raises an error or shows nothing useful unless they are global elsewhere.

drawDebugMenu.desc: Draws the 'Vehicle Inventory' and 'Current Listings' sections (offers with Accept/Decline via career_modules_marketplace.acceptOffer/declineOffer) and the 'Generate Random Offer' button (generateOffer).
